comment_regular: Return true only when an active NiTimeController can reuse its previous interpolation result. Active bit is NiTimeController.flags +0x08 bit 3. On an application-time change, computeScaledTimeOnUpdate +0x2C normally calls virtual ComputeScaledTime and refreshes cachedScaledTime +0x28; forceUpdate +0x38 forces one changed result and is cleared. If +0x2C is zero, report changed without recomputing +0x28.
